```{python}
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 2.8
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

# Generate Autonomous Waypoint Trajectory & Sensor Field Thumbnail
t = np.linspace(0, 10, 150)
x = t
y = 1.5 * np.sin(0.6 * t) + 0.15 * t

wp_x = [1.0, 3.5, 6.2, 8.8]
wp_y = [1.5 * np.sin(0.6 * wx) + 0.15 * wx for wx in wp_x]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 2.8))
ax.plot(x, y, color='#1c528b', linewidth=2.5, zorder=3)
ax.fill_between(x, y - 0.55, y + 0.55, color='#06b6d4', alpha=0.14, zorder=1)
ax.scatter(wp_x, wp_y, color='#ed7953', s=75, zorder=4)
for wx, wy in zip(wp_x, wp_y):
    circle = plt.Circle((wx, wy), 0.55, color='#ed7953', fill=False, linestyle='--', alpha=0.5)
    ax.add_patch(circle)

ax.axis('off')
plt.tight_layout(pad=0)
plt.show()
```

<!-- CARD 2: SUSTAINABLE AVIATION FUEL -->
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
::: {.card .h-100}
```{python}
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 2.8
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

# Generate Process Conversion & Carbon Reduction Curve Thumbnail
t = np.linspace(0, 8, 200)
conv = 1 - np.exp(-0.55 * t)
emissions = np.exp(-0.45 * t)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 2.8))
ax.plot(t, conv, color='#10b981', linewidth=2.8)
ax.plot(t, emissions, color='#1c528b', linewidth=2.2, linestyle='--')
ax.fill_between(t, conv, color='#10b981', alpha=0.14)
ax.scatter([4.2], [1 - np.exp(-0.55 * 4.2)], color='#ed7953', s=75, zorder=5)
ax.axis('off')
plt.tight_layout(pad=0)
plt.show()
```

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
::: {.card .h-100}
```{python}
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 2.8
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

# Generate Balanced 3-Phase AC Sine Waveforms Thumbnail
t = np.linspace(0, 3*np.pi, 300)
va = np.sin(t)
vb = np.sin(t - 2*np.pi/3)
vc = np.sin(t + 2*np.pi/3)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 2.8))
ax.axhline(0, color='#cbd5e1', linewidth=1, zorder=1)
ax.plot(t, va, color='#1c528b', linewidth=2.5)
ax.plot(t, vb, color='#ed7953', linewidth=2.5, linestyle='--')
ax.plot(t, vc, color='#a855f7', linewidth=2.5, linestyle=':')
ax.axis('off')
plt.tight_layout(pad=0)
plt.show()
```
